dependency_edges.handoff: The cleaned cross-section supplies the four performance indicators.
The performance index becomes the post-LASSO dependent variable.
The controllability-filtered contributors become GAM response variables.
Fitted finite differences become the homogeneous contributor ROI.
Institution-specific ROI sets become inputs to the discrete allocation.
Funded institutions and amounts become the annual state-update inputs.
The baseline allocation becomes the object adjusted for geographic concentration.
